text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon is explaining a new fan

appreciation event that the committee
has
planned. It's called...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The "Win Big! ☆ Umazing Prizes
Handpicked by
Top Umamusume! ♪"
event.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am pleased that the name is suitably
accurate.
Several students have been
nominated by the
academy to each
prepare one present.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The participants are currently behind
schedule in
obtaining their presents, so I
am executing my
"insistence" protocol.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I estimate that a high level of

communication ability is required. Before

proceeding, I will scan for a viable
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Committee members should
not
inflict unnecessary stress on targets.
choice_data_list: 相手を気遣ってるんだな
相手を気遣ってるんだね

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I must find a way to minimize the risk of
triggering
a "pressured" status.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...!
Calculations complete. "Good idea"
obtained.
Trainer, do you possess spare
time?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I predict that the tense mood of a
two-party
conversation can be lessened
by introducing a
third party.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Summarizing... Please grant my request
for your
accompaniment.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Target one is Copano Rickey. Scanning
indicates
she has returned directly to the
dorms.
choice_data_list: そのくらいお安い御用だよ

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bourbon? What's this qi I feel...
Could you be
here about the gift?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Lucky! ☆ This is a fortuitous meeting! I
just got
back from buying it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Here you go! It's a luck-bringing owl
figurine! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Present received.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sorry it's late. I wanted to find the most

auspicious direction to buy it in and
ended up
going to the next prefecture
over!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ Auspicious directions have
more
powerful effects the farther out we
go, you see!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It was quite the endeavor finding a shop!
But I
really wanted whoever wins that to
gain lots of
luck!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Processing... You spent time and labor to
activate
"good fortune" for the winner.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Not satisfied with giving an ordinary
object, you
charged it first with
"consideration."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right! ☆ And I hope the person who
wins your
present gets lots of good qi
from it too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My... pres... en...
...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wah! There's a sudden imbalance
between her yin
and yang! W-we need
to restore harmony, fast!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Restart complete. I apologize for earlier.
My
status has returned to normal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I had my background processes
selecting one.
However, with no
selection criteria definitions,
my thought
processes became overloaded.
choice_data_list: えっと、ブルボンのプレゼントは……？

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
First target detected. Scanning indicates
target is
resting. Initiating contact.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yawn... Hm? What are you two doing here?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! I'm so sorry, I completely forgot
about
that...
choice_data_list: 例のプレゼントを預かりに！

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Do not worry. I extended the deadline,
so if I can
collect it by then, there will
be no error.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But... what if I forget again? I'll just have
to get it
right now. I'll be right back.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Here it is.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I went and brought a fresh pair from
my
locker. I buy them in bulk, so I
always have extra.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Confirming... These items are dear to
you,
Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's the same way a fan reacted
once.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You see... Right after I debuted, I gave a
fan
these cleats.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know what would be appropriate
until
they made a request for "something
I love." It
turned out these made them
really happy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I hand out a pair of
cleats in
times like this.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know much about anything
besides
racing... but I'm always confident
these will do the
trick.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, speaking of, what's your present,
Bourbon?
I'm excited to see what you
got.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My... pres... en...
...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Did you... lose power? Um,
here! Maybe
a strawberry mochi will
help!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Restart complete. I apologize for earlier.
My
status has returned to normal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I had my background processes
selecting one.
However, with no
selection criteria definitions,
my thought
processes became overloaded.
choice_data_list: えっと、ブルボンのプレゼントは……？

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Processing was paused to focus on other
tasks.
Due to continued inactivity, I
suddenly
experienced a forced
shutdown.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Carelessness" identified.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But I gained substantial sample data
during my
"insistence" protocol.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Once the new data is fully installed, I
will
promptly rerun the "optimal present
selection"
task.
